notes.title: Phageborn new update
notes.notes:
Dear Phageborn community,
 
Earlier this year we announced that we are working hard on bringing you the new version of our beloved game Phageborn, but that to avoid confusion that at the time the game needed to be removed from Steam. In the end that didn't prove possible, because we realized that the way the Steam rules work if we took the game down it would have been deleted permanently. 
 
Of course, we wanted to avoid that because
- we wanted to make sure that everyone who had supported us got to keep the game
- we would have had to release the new version under a different name and ID
 
The bottom line is that we felt removing the game would be unfair to you - our most precious community.
 
It's taken us much longer than it should have to come back and explain that - and we are sorry about that - but hopefully we can show that we are now working towards getting a new release together so we can start delivering an amazing game experience.
 
For just now the game is still here but we have decided that we need to keep the servers off whilst we work on the next release. The game you deserve.
 
Those of you who have already purchased the game are our true heroes. Without you, there's no Phageborn. 
 
We will share some details of the new updates over the next few weeks and let you know when the new build is coming - and we hope you will be blown away by it.
 
We cannot express enough how much we appreciate all of your support!
 
Thank you again, 
 
Games Revolted Team

notes.title: PHAGEBORN CURRENT SITUATION UPDATE
notes.notes:
Dear friends and fans, 

Today, Games Revolted made the difficult decision to put all Phageborn Online Card Game related business operations on hold following a challenging period affected by the current situation in our hometown. 

Our company, together with its investor has suffered significant damage in the last month. 
The unpredictable COVID-19 situation affected our investor greatly due to the nature of their business and, as difficult as it already was, the situation was compounded by the devastating earthquake that hit Zagreb where our offices are located.

We’re genuinely sad and disappointed not to be able to continue working on Phageborn at this moment and stay on schedule with planned updates and new chapters of the Phageborn story. 

The Games Revolted team is extremely proud of releasing Phageborn Online Card Game after 3+ years of development and even more thankful to every single player who tried the game, enjoyed it, took the time to write the precious feedback, participated in our discord discussions or being part of our story in any way.
